gloss: to refuse; to reject; to deny

definitions.gloss: to refuse; to reject; to deny; to turn down
definitions.explanation: To firmly decline a request, demand, or offer. Stronger and more formal than {断|ことわ}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拒否|きょひ}された。
examples.english: I was denied entry into the country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拒否|きょひ}した。

⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい}→労働組合：16096_roudoukumiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拒否|きょひ}する⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}さなかった→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧。
examples.english: The company maintained its stance of refusing the labor union's demands.

notes:
Compound of {拒|きょ} (refuse) + {否|ひ} (deny). A strong, formal word for refusal. Implies a firm, definitive rejection rather than a polite decline.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{拒否|きょひ}{反応|はんのう}→拒否反応：21642_kyohihannou⟧: rejection reaction (medical)
- ⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧{権|けん}: right to refuse; veto
- ⟦{着信|ちゃくしん}→着信：07685_chakushin⟧⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧: call blocking
- {受|う}け{取|と}り⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧: refusal to accept delivery
- ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧: denial of entry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: to decline, to turn down (everyday, can be polite)
- ⟦{却下|きゃっか}→却下：05908_kyakka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reject (official decisions — applications, proposals)
- ⟦{否認|ひにん}する→否認する：22511_hininsuru⟧: to deny (facts, allegations — legal contexts)
